checks.name: dev-certs
checks.message: HTTPS development certificate is only partially trusted
checks.fix: Set SSL_CERT_DIR in your shell profile: export SSL_CERT_DIR="$SSL_CERT_DIR:/usr/lib/ssl/certs:/home/agent/.aspnet/dev-certs/trust"
checks.details: The certificate is in the trusted store, but SSL_CERT_DIR is not configured to include '/home/agent/.aspnet/dev-certs/trust'. Some applications may not trust the certificate. 'aspire run' will configure this automatically.

checks.name: dev-certs-certutil
checks.message: certutil is not available; browser certificate trust may be incomplete
checks.fix: Install certutil from your distribution's NSS tools package (for example, libnss3-tools).
checks.details: Aspire uses certutil to query and update NSS certificate databases used by Firefox and Chromium browsers on Linux.
